build_dynamic_conv_layer: build a DynamicConv module with specified input size, kernel size, and number of heads for dynamic convolution
create_dynamic_conv_1d_tbc: create a DynamicConv1dTBC module for lightweight convolution on T x B x C shaped tensors
run_dynamic_conv_forward: run the forward pass of DynamicConv1dTBC on input tensors with optional incremental state
test_linear_initialization: test the Linear helper function that creates an nn.Linear layer with Xavier uniform weight initialization
review_dynamic_conv_unfolded_forward: review the _forward_unfolded method of DynamicConv1dTBC that uses conventional unfolding for convolution
